title: The Circle of Life
description:
This project presents a minimal, observer-invariant framework for understanding life and death without narrative, metaphysics, or intent-based explanation.
Life is defined as the persistence of coherence under constraint.
Death is defined as the boundary transition that occurs when coherence can no longer be preserved.
Under this framework, life and death are not opposites, failures, or moral states. They are phases within a single lawful process governed by constraint, coherence, and boundary conditions across scale.
Pressure does not destroy systems; loss of coherence does.
When coherence cannot be maintained, transition is forced.
This transition is not an error—it is the mechanism by which structure reorganizes and persists at other scales.
The “circle of life” is therefore not metaphorical. It is a structural cycle:
coherence emerges,
coherence is maintained,
constraints tighten,
a boundary is crossed,
form dissolves,
components re-enter the system elsewhere.
This project does not propose new entities, forces, or intentions.
It does not replace biology, physics, or medicine.
It offers a coordinate system that unifies how life, illness, collapse, death, and renewal are understood across domains.
Core Law (Condensed)
Coherence persists under constraint; loss of coherence forces boundary transition.
Scope and Status
Closed
Minimal
Observer-invariant
Domain-invariant
Bias-free
Executable
Falsifiable
This project is intentionally complete as written.
Any extension or modification constitutes a separate project.
